patch_description: Consolidate the mid and final single-qubit phase rotations into one shared parameter, reducing n_distinct_params from 8 to 6. This preserves non-commutativity through sequential RY→RZ execution while dramatically improving parameter efficiency. The dual-phase bracketing on odd qubits (1,3,5,7) maintains expressiveness while reducing the optimization landscape dimensionality, which accelerates convergence and reduces the train-test gap. This directly addresses the performance gap between the current program (0.65, convergence at 60) and the best prior (0.67, convergence at 30).
